statusDefinitions.settled: Use as the default backend and UX contract unless new cross-corpus evidence reopens it.
statusDefinitions.configurable: The semantic boundary is settled, but product/destination policy may choose among controlled options.
statusDefinitions.open: Do not hard-code yet; evidence or implementation design is still required.

decisions.decision: Use SourceRow → Item → Step → Flow → Bundle/Flow Map → Projection.
decisions.why: It separates evidence, state, semantic grouping, discovery grouping, and destination format.
decisions.backendAction: Preserve stable references at every level.
decisions.uxMeaning: UX may hide hierarchy levels, but it must not merge their ownership.

decisions.decision: SourceRow is the minimum evidence unit; Item is the minimum independently stateful execution unit.
decisions.why: One source fact and one user completion are related but not always 1:1.
decisions.backendAction: Store both identities and their N:M relations.
decisions.uxMeaning: Users check Items, not SourceRows.

decisions.decision: Support 1:1, many:1, 1:many, and many:many SourceRow↔Item mappings.
decisions.why: Merge and split are valid only when source action boundaries support them.
decisions.backendAction: Use SourceReferences plus an accounting sidecar.
decisions.uxMeaning: A concise Item can still show all source evidence.

decisions.decision: Every captured SourceRow maps to Item, Field, Memo, or an omission with reason.
decisions.why: This makes loss and over-generation auditable.
decisions.backendAction: Reject complete fixtures with unaccounted rows.
decisions.uxMeaning: Omitted source detail is deliberate, not silently lost.

decisions.decision: Keep entity-level SourceRefs and add property-level provenance in a conversion-audit sidecar.
decisions.why: An Item can have source-backed title but an unsupported schedule or completion.
decisions.backendAction: Trace title, completion, schedule, and every source-filled value separately.
decisions.uxMeaning: Source explanation can be shown without exposing internal audit detail.

decisions.decision: Create an Item only for source-derived or explicit user-requested behavior worth independent state.
decisions.why: Facts, cautions, and method details should not become fake checks.
decisions.backendAction: Require intent, completion, order, and SourceRefs.
decisions.uxMeaning: The execution list stays action-focused.

decisions.decision: Field holds typed schedule/sort/filter/record/export/generation values; Memo holds context, method, links, experience, caution, and free text.
decisions.why: Neither typed data nor explanatory text should be inflated into Items.
decisions.backendAction: Store Field owner/purpose/valueSource and typed Memo kind.
decisions.uxMeaning: Only necessary setup and run inputs become controls.

decisions.decision: Use five intents and three completion modes from Taxonomy v1.1; consume is use_resource plus check/record completion.
decisions.why: Intent and proof of done are orthogonal.
decisions.backendAction: Reject free-text intent/completion enums.
decisions.uxMeaning: A lesson can be consumed while progress is checked or recorded.

decisions.decision: Item.schedule is authoritative; Step grouping and row order never invent dates.
decisions.why: Semantic groups and actual dates change independently.
decisions.backendAction: Support absolute, date_window, anchor_offset, and structured recurrence.
decisions.uxMeaning: Undated progress remains usable without Calendar.

decisions.decision: An Item without an effective schedule produces no VEVENT.
decisions.why: Calendar placement must come from source or user evidence.
decisions.backendAction: Hard-reject undated VEVENT generation.
decisions.uxMeaning: Offer Checklist, Todo, Sheet, or Memo instead of asking for a fake date.

decisions.decision: VCALENDAR contains sibling VEVENT/VTODO components; Flow, Step, and Map are not nested iCalendar components.
decisions.why: iCalendar components do not represent the canonical hierarchy or completion ownership.
decisions.backendAction: Never nest VEVENT and VTODO; allow VALARM only as a component child.
decisions.uxMeaning: Calendar is one view/export, not the data model.

decisions.decision: New canonical data chooses one primary artifact from calendar/checklist/todo/sheet/memo and never persists hybrid.
decisions.why: Hybrid hides which result actually carries the user job.
decisions.backendAction: Store distinct secondary artifacts.
decisions.uxMeaning: Show one recommended result and optional alternatives.

decisions.decision: Never ask the user for a source-owned value already captured.
decisions.why: The product value is reducing re-entry.
decisions.backendAction: Generate input contract from Field ownership and provenance.
decisions.uxMeaning: Most first runs need zero to two setup values.

decisions.decision: Step groups source/user semantics, Flow owns one user job and primary source, and Map groups independently usable Flows without owning execution state.
decisions.why: This prevents discovery structure from mutating Item state.
decisions.backendAction: Keep Item state references outside Step/Flow/Map.
decisions.uxMeaning: The UI can present projects and variants without duplicating checks.

decisions.decision: Separate source, creator/published version, conversion audit, user overlay, execution run, projection, and internal review.
decisions.why: Updates must not rewrite source truth or past user execution.
decisions.backendAction: Use versioned immutable content and separate overlay/run records.
decisions.uxMeaning: Users can keep personal edits while seeing source updates.

decisions.decision: Recurring execution state is owned by Item plus occurrenceKey; recurring Items are not cloned into canonical Items.
decisions.why: One content definition can have many personal sessions.
decisions.backendAction: Persist occurrence state in ExecutionRun.
decisions.uxMeaning: Each session can be checked independently.

decisions.decision: One primary source controls each Flow; supporting sources may add boundaries or utilities but not silent actions.
decisions.why: Source provenance and creator meaning remain inspectable.
decisions.backendAction: Require exactly one primarySourceId per Flow.
decisions.uxMeaning: Users can understand whose experience or official guide they are following.

decisions.decision: Structure completeness and public readiness are independent.
decisions.why: Medical, parenting, legal, and rights-limited content can still test data shape when exact rows exist.
decisions.backendAction: Keep minimal review sidecar with publicReadiness=not_assessed.
decisions.uxMeaning: Research artifacts must not be shown as publicly approved content.

decisions.decision: VTODO is disabled by default until destination capability is proven; non-Calendar fallbacks are mandatory.
decisions.why: Client import/re-export and relation preservation were not tested.
decisions.backendAction: Gate VTODO by destination capability.
decisions.uxMeaning: Offer Checklist/Todo/Sheet/Memo that works even without VTODO.

decisions.decision: Automated/schema/browser QA is not observed-user validation or external Calendar round-trip evidence.
decisions.why: Internal consistency and real-world behavior are different claims.
decisions.backendAction: Persist verification status explicitly.
decisions.uxMeaning: Planning reports must label NOT_RUN tests.

decisions.decision: Allow a source-backed Field/Memo template to contain zero Items without inventing an action, and mark it structure_only_no_items.
decisions.why: A form definition can prove SourceRow→Field and Sheet projection structure but is not itself an independently executable Flow.
decisions.backendAction: Require at least one Field or Memo, a usable non-Calendar projection, complete row accounting, and an explicit non-executable decision.
decisions.uxMeaning: Show the template fields without a fake checkbox such as 'fill the form'.

decisions.decision: Choose per_item by default; allow step_bundle for one equal-schedule user moment with child IDs and declared completion loss.
decisions.why: Compact display is useful in some destinations but cannot own child state.
decisions.backendAction: Accept calendarPolicy none/per_item/step_bundle per projection request.
decisions.uxMeaning: Users may choose compact calendar display without losing FlowMe checks.

decisions.decision: Choose RRULE master or bounded expanded instances by destination/request.
decisions.why: Both serialize the same recurrence with different portability and state loss.
decisions.backendAction: Never mix modes in one projection result.
decisions.uxMeaning: Explain whether calendar shows one repeating event or separate instances.

decisions.decision: Use source reminder when present; otherwise let product/user choose at most one reminder without changing the official window.
decisions.why: The window is source truth, while reminder timing may be personal.
decisions.backendAction: Separate window fields from reminder overlay.
decisions.uxMeaning: Show the full official period and a clear personal reminder.

decisions.decision: Choose source period, phase, week, procedure group, row group, or user moment as Step grouping.
decisions.why: Several groupings can preserve the same Item semantics.
decisions.backendAction: Store stable Step IDs and grouping rationale.
decisions.uxMeaning: Presentation can use the grouping easiest for the user job.

decisions.decision: Include source, caution, and user memo according to target and request, while never exporting internal review.
decisions.why: A calendar event needs enough detail to execute, while a compact Todo may not.
decisions.backendAction: Use explicit projection profile flags.
decisions.uxMeaning: Advanced export options do not become required setup.

decisions.decision: Use Item/occurrence identity columns always and add typed Field columns required by the job.
decisions.why: Different jobs need comparison, progress, or record columns.
decisions.backendAction: Generate columns from Field definitions, not slugs.
decisions.uxMeaning: Sheets stay small and task-specific.

decisions.decision: Labels, hints, optional advanced values, and defaults may vary by content while value ownership remains fixed.
decisions.why: The same anchor semantic needs domain-specific language.
decisions.backendAction: Keep stable field keys and localized labels.
decisions.uxMeaning: Use familiar wording such as 이사일 or 시작일.

decisions.decision: Choose Flow-level or Step-level memo documents by source size and destination limits.
decisions.why: Both preserve context without changing canonical Items.
decisions.backendAction: Return included scopes and loss manifest.
decisions.uxMeaning: Avoid one excessively long note when Step documents are clearer.

decisions.decision: Whether to persist a first-class cross-Flow SharedContext entity.
decisions.why: Flow setup Fields cover current needs; adopt only after repeated independent cross-Flow cases.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: At least three fixtures that cannot be modeled cleanly with Flow setup Fields and bindings.
decisions.temporaryRule: Use experimental sharedContextBindings in the audit sidecar only.

decisions.decision: Whether source-explicit optionality becomes a canonical Item property.
decisions.why: Canonical v1 has no field and optionality may affect inclusion rather than completion.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Repeated UX/backend need across independent fixtures.
decisions.temporaryRule: Store a traced boolean in conversion-audit sidecar.

decisions.decision: The canonical predicate language and supported condition operators.
decisions.why: Free-form or domain-sensitive judgment must not become an unsafe automation rule.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: A small common set of explicit, source-backed predicates.
decisions.temporaryRule: Simple sidecar predicate or Memo; no automatic date/action invention.

decisions.decision: Whether dependency edges become canonical and which relation types are supported.
decisions.why: Most sequence needs are already represented by order; dependencies should add real blocking semantics.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Independent cases requiring stateful blocking, not merely presentation order.
decisions.temporaryRule: Sidecar finish-before-start edge, acyclic and source-explicit.

decisions.decision: How a condition-triggered due date is represented and resolved.
decisions.why: Canonical v1 schedules lack trigger expressions.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Common deterministic formulas with clear source/user operands.
decisions.temporaryRule: Keep Item undated until the trigger resolves.

decisions.decision: A complete user-owned add/edit/delete Item contract.
decisions.why: UserFlowCopy can hide or edit published Items but does not fully model private added Items and their history.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: UX rules for authorship, provenance, sync, and version review.
decisions.temporaryRule: Use included=false for exclusion; do not mutate published canonical content.

decisions.decision: Whether property-level provenance is promoted from conversion-audit sidecar into canonical core.
decisions.why: It is required for generation QA but may be too heavy for every read path.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Backend query, correction, and version-resolution requirements.
decisions.temporaryRule: Persist sidecar linked to content ID/version.

decisions.decision: Destination-specific VTODO, RELATED-TO, X-property, and recurrence round-trip support.
decisions.why: Local syntax checks do not prove Google/Outlook/Apple behavior.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Real account import, edit, re-export, and identity tests.

decisions.decision: Exact UID hashing/escaping and migration from legacy export UIDs.
decisions.why: Semantic identity is settled, but changing UIDs can duplicate existing calendar events.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Backend ID design and external round-trip fixtures.
decisions.temporaryRule: Use deterministic copyId+ItemId+occurrenceKey in research DTOs.

decisions.decision: Whether users prefer per-item versus compact Step bundles, default artifacts, and zero-to-two-input setup.
decisions.why: Corpus and automated QA cannot establish usability or save intent.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Observed open, setup, export, check, return, and correction behavior.
decisions.temporaryRule: Expose conservative defaults and record the choice as configurable.

backendCanStartWith: sidecar-only treatment for open structure fields
